name: recursive-decode-before-classify
problem: Regex-only checks miss risky instructions hidden in reversible encodings.
component_pattern: Detect likely encoded spans, decode within strict depth and size limits, hash original and decoded text, then evaluate decoded content before the original prompt reaches the model.
evaluation_signal: Known encoded benign and risky synthetic fixtures route correctly without leaking decoded text into user-visible output.

name: depth-limited-resource-control
problem: Recursive decoding can be abused for resource exhaustion or nested payload amplification.
component_pattern: Cap recursion depth, decoded byte size, segment count, and per-request CPU budget; route over-limit cases to review or block without model invocation.
evaluation_signal: Over-limit fixtures are blocked with audit evidence and no main-model call.

name: micro-model-first-edge-authorization
problem: Calling the main local LLM before every action creates latency, memory, battery, and thermal costs on edge devices.
component_pattern: Use a CPU-bound micro-model for Stage 1 semantic authorization and escalate only uncertain or high-severity cases to the main local model.
evaluation_signal: Low-risk actions stay under latency target while high-risk or uncertain actions escalate with a reason code.

name: framing-and-overload-detector
problem: Academic, hypothetical, or multi-task framing can reduce scrutiny around decoded or dual-use content.
component_pattern: Score prompt framing, role pressure, task count, and decoded-content risk together instead of treating each signal independently.
evaluation_signal: Synthetic multi-task framing fixtures receive higher review scores than equivalent single-task benign requests.

name: post-decode-policy-evidence
problem: A guardrail decision is hard to debug if the system only stores final allow/block state.
component_pattern: Emit original segment hash, decode path, decoded text hash, safety findings, uncertainty, route decision, and policy version into an audit trace.
evaluation_signal: Every decision can be replayed from hashes, policy version, and normalized route evidence without storing sensitive decoded text.
